vc-single-r150.hypothesis: One computed damping confirmation: measured50to100ohm peak slope predicts~7.447mA at150ohm. FreezeRafterthispoint; preserve3/7mAtargets,69MOSandall7sources.

vc-single-r100.hypothesis: Same69MOSsingle-stage topology; increase existing RAD/RADB50to100ohm to damp fast input Miller feedthrough after7.584mA overshoot seen in undampedcontrol. No changing light-source calibration range.

vc-single.hypothesis: Remove first two CMOS inverters (4MOS); feed remaining GP inverter from DBI and GN inverter from DI, retaining output W12/24 and actual DR. Test less cascaded pulse compression versus greater input port capacitance.

vc-ff20.hypothesis: Two DI-to-GP/DBI-to-GN passive feedforward capacitors supply early gate charge from already metered input ports; test gate delay versus rebound/stress.

vc-ff40.hypothesis: One bounded feedforward dose control; double20fF only if20fF node behavior justifies it.

vc-dr65.hypothesis: Reduce actual predriver regulator feedback target from~3.1V to~2.45V without changing raw3.3V sources or laser rail. Test smaller swing energy versus lower gate overdrive.
